description: Check a session's whole workbook for modeling problems and return a JSON report: broken references, circular references and whether they converge, hardcoded plugs (a constant or odd formula breaking a run of consistent formulas), external links, volatile functions, hidden sheets and names, stale cached values, and a verification block comparing Basis's computed values with the ones Excel last saved. Recalculates first and changes nothing else. Use it as a health check before trusting or handing off a model; for structure only use inspect_model, for one value's lineage trace_dependencies, and to compare two files diff_workbooks.

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

title: Audit workbook
